checks.checked: Countability, K conjugation closure, finite-edge hypotheses, finite lcm, vertex strong Atiyah assumptions, full maps of arbitrary finitely generated projectives, both K0-surjections, algebraic versus center-valued assertions, T_VLI and weak K1 coefficient ring.
checks.result: Quantifiers and dependencies identified; class-scope defect P001 affects Theorems 1.6-1.7.

checks.topic: Regular closures, rank, dimensions and traces
checks.checked: Proper star structure, uniqueness of relative inverses, flatness over regular rings, epic closure, subgroup dimension induction, discreteness including infinite dimensions, semisimplicity criterion, positive finite-rank trace and cyclicity.
checks.result: Internal applications checked. Original Henneke thesis unavailable; its cited closure/semisimplicity results remain an explicitly recorded external-source limitation.

checks.topic: Graphs of rings and universal localization
checks.checked: Edge monomorphisms, semisimple edge rings, induced-submodule/projective results, right-exact cokernel in Lemma 2.13, split kernels/cokernels in Lemma 2.14, stable induced projectives, localization transitivity and hereditary epic semisimple Tor criterion.
checks.result: Bergman and Dicks 1977 originals checked. Dicks 1983 and full Schofield source pages unavailable; their restatements and surrounding manuscript arguments checked without claiming original-source verification.

checks.topic: Amalgam normal forms and finite-edge trace identity
checks.checked: Deletion operator and right B-action; right A commutator; cyclic trace on finite-rank compositions; finite-C averaging; the degenerate A=C or B=C case; exact location where finiteness is essential.
checks.result: No supported defect in the checked complex-coefficient argument.

checks.checked: Dicks Mayer-Vietoris lifting/flatness hypothesis over vertex regular rings; epic tensor reductions; Ore flatness from N(G) to U(G); l2 factorization and complex-bilinear finite-rank operator identification; trace intersection.
checks.result: Complex argument checked. General-field passage NE001 unresolved; no claimed Tor counterexample.

checks.topic: Strong Atiyah for amalgams and projective rank
checks.checked: Pure inclusion of regular closure into U(G); epic multiplication and image replacement; hereditary Tor2 vanishing; induced vertex decomposition; denominator divisibility; full-map localization; faithfulness via positive vertex dimensions rather than K0 surjectivity alone.
checks.result: Implicit purity/image step supplied independently; no additional supported Problem.

checks.checked: Stable-letter kernel as a tree amalgam; finite exhaustion; skew Laurent crossed product; semiprime/noetherian hypotheses; analytic invertibility of regular elements using Reich 8.16-8.17; Ore-flat and Shapiro Tor transfer; stable induction from K0.
checks.result: Relevant Reich original proof pages checked. Stable induction suffices; no unsupported assertion that K0 alone gives an unstabilized decomposition.

checks.topic: Arbitrary graphs and directed finite data
checks.checked: Finite connected subgraph directed system; countable group versus possibly redundant uncountable graph; finite idempotents, matrix relations, factorization ranks and localization descent; vertex and finite-subgroup K0-surjectivity.
checks.result: A directed net supplies the exhaustion argument; no separate defect established by graph countability alone.

checks.topic: Virtual local indicability and class induction
checks.checked: Finite-index normal subgroups; char-zero finite crossed-product semisimplicity; transfer of localizations; actual Definition 6.1 closure operations; every Y_alpha group is VLI; failure of directed-union closure; finite-lcm counterexample; repaired class identity T_VLI=Loc(Y).
checks.result: P001 Major, decisive analytic counterexample plus exact rational affine calculation. Class repair proved, full revised-proof acceptance pending.

checks.topic: Locally indicable division rings and weak K1
checks.checked: Hughes-free K-division rings in Jaikin-Lopez-Alvarez; general-graph semifir/localization lemma in Fisher-Sanchez-Peralta; Lueck-Linnell injective-localization and endomorphism hypotheses; coefficient fraction field; rational closure; Morita and Dieudonne determinant.
checks.result: Selected originals checked. Theorem 1.7 retains dependency on Theorem 1.6 and P001; NE001 separate.
